summary.text: Mary Lou Marzian is a Democratic state representative from Kentucky House District 41 who took office on January 1, 2025, and is running unopposed for re-election on November 3, 2026. She previously represented District 34 from 1995 to 2023 and is a registered nurse.

paragraphs.text: Mary Lou Marzian earned an associate degree in 1974 and a bachelor's degree in 1979 from the University of Louisville.

Her professional experience includes working as a registered nurse and transplant coordinator at the University of Louisville, in dialysis home training, and as a registered nurse at Jewish Hospital in Louisville, and she has been a member of the Kentucky Nurses Association and the American Civil Liberties Union.
Marzian represented Kentucky House District 34 from 1995 to 2023, when Sarah Stalker succeeded her, and in 2025 she succeeded Josie Raymond in District 41.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Elections, Const. Amendments & Intergovernmental Affairs, Health and Family Services, House Judiciary, and Tourism and Outdoor Recreation committees.
